control_flow_argument.claim: Fresh engine begins with _preferences None and counts.nodes0. Root case constructs that fresh engine and calls search once; initial state/census does not install a pending preference.
This exact Root case sets MAXIMUM_NODES2 and passes it to the fresh engine.

Each search.walk while iteration checks the node ceiling, then increments nodes before decision and at most one _select_family_branch call. At most two selections can be reached, including siblings or children; recursion depth alone is not the bound.

Each selection has at most one CONTINUATION and at most one provider plus BATCH check. CONTINUATION READY returns immediately; INVALIDATED clears pending; NO_MATCH clears pending only when selection is None. Clearing permits fresh BATCH in the same selection. UNKNOWN retaining pending does not add BATCH.
Each _consume_family calls the consumer once; branch adoption may carry pending preferences into the next counted selection. Initial empty preferences excludes CONTINUATION at the first selection.
